framing.lineOfInquiry: Priya Malhotra (P00166) may have been involved in the incident recorded in CASE018
framing.alternate: Priya Malhotra (P00166) was not involved — the evidence has an innocent explanation
framing.note: KRONOS starts from the presumption of innocence. The line of inquiry and the alternates are tested against the same records; neither is a finding, and the strengths are not probabilities.

alternateHypotheses.title: The location records are unreliable
alternateHypotheses.statement: Priya Malhotra's location records are imprecise or inconsistent (tower-level accuracy, cloned or shared SIM), so they do not reliably place them at the scene.
alternateHypotheses.label: Moderate

evidence.text: The record placing them near the scene (CDR) is only accurate to about 1.5 km

alternateHypotheses.test: Request a tower dump and the handset's GPS logs; check for SIM cloning; rely on high-accuracy fixes only.

alternateHypotheses.title: Named or given a role in error
alternateHypotheses.statement: Priya Malhotra was named in the FIR, or assigned a role, without an independent basis.
alternateHypotheses.label: Weak

evidence.text: Recorded in the FIR as complainant, not as accused
FIR text contains: '…no role has been attributed…'

alternateHypotheses.test: Re-examine the FIR and statements; record the person's statement and the informant's basis for naming them.

alternateHypotheses.title: The contact was routine, not coordination
alternateHypotheses.statement: Priya Malhotra's calls and messages reflect a long-standing relationship (family, work, business), not planning of the incident.
alternateHypotheses.label: Weak

evidence.text: In contact with Nitin Bhatia since 2025-02-24, 28 days before the incident (2 calls, 4 messages) — a long-standing relationship
In contact with Manoj Singh since 2025-02-25, 27 days before the incident (3 calls, 6 messages) — a long-standing relationship
In contact with Pooja Rawat since 2025-02-26, 26 days before the incident (3 calls, 2 messages) — a long-standing relationship

alternateHypotheses.test: Examine message content and the timing of contact relative to the incident; establish the relationship.

alternatesConsideredNotSupported.title: Was near the scene for a routine reason
Someone else used the phone or handset

comparison.verdict: Open: the line of inquiry (0.58) and the strongest alternate — A8 the location records are unreliable (0.55) — are similarly supported. The tests below would separate them.

A6 — Re-examine the FIR and statements; record the person's statement and the informant's basis for naming them.
A5 — Examine message content and the timing of contact relative to the incident; establish the relationship.
